termsPage.title: Terms of Use
termsPage.intro: By using PaceHive, you agree to the terms below. Please read carefully before continuing.

sections.title: 1. About PaceHive
sections.text: PaceHive is a digital platform that connects runners to local running guides. We act as intermediaries — we are not a travel agency, transportation company, or the employer of registered guides.

sections.title: 2. Use of the platform
sections.text: PaceHive may only be used by people 18 or older. By signing up, you agree to these terms and our Privacy Policy. Using the platform for illegal, fraudulent purposes, or purposes that harm third parties is prohibited.

sections.title: 3. Responsibility for payments
sections.text: When a guide charges for the service, payment is agreed upon and made directly between runner and guide, outside the platform. PaceHive does not process, mediate, guarantee, or hold any responsibility for financial transactions between its users.

sections.title: 4. Responsibility for activities
sections.text: PaceHive is not responsible for accidents, injuries, material losses, or any other damages occurring during or after runs. Each user is responsible for assessing their physical condition and surroundings before any activity.

sections.title: 5. Independent guides
sections.text: Registered guides are independent service providers. There is no employment, corporate, or any other relationship between guides and PaceHive. The platform does not guarantee the quality, safety, or accuracy of information provided by guides.

sections.title: 6. User conduct
sections.text: All users are expected to act with mutual respect, honesty, and good faith. PaceHive reserves the right to suspend or cancel accounts that show abusive, discriminatory, fraudulent behavior, or that violate these terms.

sections.title: 7. Service availability
sections.text: PaceHive strives to keep the platform available 24 hours a day but does not guarantee uninterrupted availability. We may perform maintenance, updates, or discontinue features without prior notice.

sections.title: 8. Changes to these terms
sections.text: These terms may be updated at any time. Material changes will be communicated by email. Continued use of the platform after changes implies acceptance of the new terms.

sections.title: 9. Jurisdiction and applicable law
sections.text: These terms are governed by the laws of the Federative Republic of Brazil. The courts of São Paulo/SP are elected to settle any disputes.

sections.title: 10. Contact
sections.text: For questions about these terms, contact us at contato@pacehive.com.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This policy describes how PaceHive collects, uses, and protects your personal data, in accordance with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD — Law 13.709/2018).

sections.title: 1. What data we collect
sections.text: We collect the data you provide when signing up: name, email, phone (optional), and profile information (city, bio, etc.). We also collect platform usage data in aggregated, anonymous form to improve our services.

sections.title: 2. How we use your data
sections.text: Your data is used to: (a) create and manage your account; (b) connect runners to guides; (c) send transactional emails related to run requests; (d) improve the platform experience. We do not use your data for third-party advertising purposes.

sections.title: 3. Data sharing
sections.text: We do not sell your data to third parties. Your contact details (email and phone) are shared with the other party only after a run is confirmed, to make the meeting possible. We may share data with service providers necessary for the platform to function (hosting, sending emails), always under a confidentiality agreement.

sections.title: 4. Storage and security
sections.text: Your data is stored on secure servers (Supabase/AWS) with encryption in transit and at rest. We follow good security practices, but no system is 100% breach-proof.

sections.title: 5. Your rights (LGPD)
sections.text: Under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law 13.709/2018), you have the right to: access your data, correct inaccurate information, request deletion of your account and data, and withdraw consent at any time. To exercise these rights, contact us at contato@pacehive.com.

sections.title: 6. Cookies
sections.text: We use essential cookies for authentication and basic platform functioning. We do not use third-party tracking cookies for advertising purposes.

sections.title: 7. Data retention
sections.text: Your data is kept while your account is active. After account deletion, data is removed within 30 days, except where retention is required by legal obligation.

sections.title: 8. Minors
sections.text: PaceHive is not intended for people under 18 and does not knowingly collect data from minors. If we identify such a case, the data will be removed immediately.

sections.title: 9. Changes to this policy
sections.text: This policy may be updated periodically. We will communicate material changes by email. Continued use of the platform implies acceptance of the current version.

sections.title: 10. Contact
sections.text: Questions about privacy or requests related to your data: contato@pacehive.com.

runnerTerms.title: 1. About PaceHive
runnerTerms.text: PaceHive is a platform connecting runners with local guides. We are an intermediary — not a travel agency, transportation company, or employer of the registered guides.

runnerTerms.title: 2. Responsibility for payments
runnerTerms.text: When a guide charges for their service, payment is arranged and made directly between you and the guide, outside the platform. PaceHive does not process, mediate, guarantee, or bear any responsibility for financial transactions between runners and guides. Vet the guide and agree on terms before making any payment.

runnerTerms.title: 3. Responsibility during the run
runnerTerms.text: You are responsible for your own safety during the run. PaceHive is not responsible for accidents, injuries, property loss, or any other damage occurring during or after the activity. Assess your physical condition and the environment before running.

runnerTerms.title: 4. Conduct
runnerTerms.text: All users are expected to show mutual respect, punctuality, and honest communication. Abusive, discriminatory, or fraudulent behavior will result in account cancellation.

runnerTerms.title: 5. Cancellations
runnerTerms.text: Cancellations should be communicated to the guide as far in advance as possible. Cancellation policy and any refunds are defined directly between runner and guide.

runnerTerms.title: 6. Personal data
runnerTerms.text: Your data is used exclusively for the platform's operation. We do not sell information to third parties. See our Privacy Policy at pacehive.com/privacidade.

guideTerms.title: 1. Nature of the relationship
guideTerms.text: By registering as a guide, you act as an independent service provider. There is no employment, corporate, or any other relationship between you and PaceHive. You are responsible for your own tax and labor obligations.

guideTerms.title: 2. Free platform use
guideTerms.text: Using PaceHive is 100% free for guides in this version. We reserve the right to introduce paid plans in the future, with advance notice to registered guides.

guideTerms.title: 3. Responsibility for payments
guideTerms.text: When you charge for your service, payment is agreed upon and received directly from each runner, outside the platform. PaceHive does not process, guarantee, or bear any responsibility for payments received. Agree on payment terms before the run.

guideTerms.title: 4. Safety and conduct
guideTerms.text: You agree to provide a safe, honest, and respectful service. Do not promise conditions you cannot fulfill. In case of an emergency during the run, prioritize the runner's safety and contact emergency services if necessary.

guideTerms.title: 5. Keeping information up to date
guideTerms.text: Keep your profile (city, availability, price, modalities) always up to date. Outdated information that causes conflicts with runners may result in account suspension.

guideTerms.title: 6. Response time
guideTerms.text: Commit to responding to requests within 24 hours. Guides with a consistently high response time may have their profile temporarily hidden.

guideTerms.title: 7. Personal data
guideTerms.text: Your data is used exclusively for the platform's operation and to facilitate contact with confirmed runners. See our Privacy Policy at pacehive.com/privacidade.
